moodys.citation_text: Per Bond Buyer chronology of LVHN's rating coverage, LVHN historically used S&P + Fitch and was not consistently rated by Moody's in this period.

sp.citation_text: S&P May 2023 'Monroe County Hospital Authority, Pennsylvania Lehigh Valley Health Network; Hospital; Joint Criteria; System' summary — A+ rating in effect, revised to negative outlook in 2023.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A rating on LVHN historical; Fitch later withdrew rating after Jefferson merger in 2024.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed A+; outlook revised to Negative from Stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Pennsylvania nonprofit health systems negative view; FY2023 operating pressures.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P 2023-05-22 summary on LVHN reflected negative outlook.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Lowered long-term rating on LVHN debt from A+ to A; outlook revised to Stable; affirmed A on Thomas Jefferson University bonds
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Post-merger with Thomas Jefferson University (August 2024). LVHN debt aligned to combined entity Jefferson Health A rating.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P 2024-10-15: 'Lehigh Valley Health Network, PA Debt Rating Lowered To A Post Merger With Thomas Jefferson University; Outlook Stable'.

moodys.citation_text: Post-Jefferson merger LVHN debt rated by Moody's at A3 (Jefferson Health rating); outlook still stable as of 2025-03-31 (Moody's negative outlook revision came in late 2025).

fitch.citation_text: Fitch maintained A on Jefferson Health (now including LVHN debt). Outlook revision to negative came in Oct 2025, AFTER window end.

outcome_class_rationale: S&P downgraded LVHN one notch (A+ to A) on Oct 15, 2024 following merger with Thomas Jefferson University. While the merger lifted the combined entity outlook to stable, the rating action on the LVHN debt was a notch downgrade. DOWNGRADE.
